seo.title: Toyota: AI-driven search media - +65% conversion in Denmark (2024)
seo.meta_description: Toyota and EssenceMediacom drive search media with AI in Denmark: up to 400,000 adjustments/month, +23% dealership traffic, and +65% conversion.
seo.resume_citable: In 2024 in Denmark, Toyota and the agency EssenceMediacom drove search media with AI, making up to 400,000 adjustments per month, reaching +23% dealership visits and +65% conversion rate, with Toyota the best-selling passenger car brand every month from January to May 2024.

faq.q: What AI did Toyota use in Denmark?
faq.a: An AI layer applied to search media that reads the intent behind each search (life stage, need) from thousands of proprietary and purchased signals, then matches the right model and adjusts delivery continuously.

faq.q: What is the scale of the setup?
faq.a: Up to 400,000 media adjustments per month, with a measured impact of +23% on dealership visits and +65% on conversion rate, in a market of about 1 million monthly searches.

pattern: AI-driven media optimization at scale (real-time search relevance)
objectif_business: Make Toyota's media presence more relevant at the moment of search to convert more intent into dealership visits and sales in the Danish market.
description: In the Danish car market (about 1 million monthly searches), EssenceMediacom shifted Toyota's media from broad targeting to AI-driven individualized relevance. The system draws on thousands of signals from proprietary and purchased platforms to tie each search to the real life stage and need behind it, then match the right Toyota model. Rather than relying on the platforms' algorithms, the team applies up to 400,000 adjustments per month to the timing and dosage of delivery. The goal is to serve the right message at the right moment on Google Search, which supported Toyota's position as the top passenger vehicle brand in Denmark every month from January to May 2024. Note that across the full year 2024, Volkswagen retook first place in the Danish market: Toyota's leadership claim covers the January-May 2024 window.
points_cles: AI-driven search media toward individualized relevance, with the agency EssenceMediacom.
Thousands of proprietary and purchased signals, up to 400,000 adjustments per month.
+65% conversion rate and +23% dealership traffic in Denmark.
Evidence B, mixed-signals status, documented leadership from January to May 2024.

resultats.metrique: Danish market (passenger vehicles), every month from January to May 2024

niveau_preuve.justification: A quantified agency case study (named media and conversion metrics), with a market result (Danish monthly leadership) corroborated by an independent market source confirming Toyota's rise in Denmark in 2024.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous optimization of search delivery, with high-frequency timing and dosage adjustments (up to 400,000 per month)
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The media team at the agency EssenceMediacom for Toyota
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The intent signals behind each search (life stage, need) crossed with proprietary and purchased signals; without these signals, the search-to-model matching and the fine-grained delivery control collapse.

etapes.detail: Gather thousands of signals from proprietary and purchased platforms to read the intent behind each search.
Use AI to tie each query to the life stage and need, then to the right Toyota model.
Apply the right timing and dosage rather than delegating to the platforms' algorithms, up to 400,000 adjustments per month.
Track the impact on conversions and dealership visits to reallocate media pressure.

prerequis_data: Access to intent signals from proprietary platforms (site, CRM) and purchased sources
Reliable tracking of online conversions and, where possible, dealership visits
The ability to segment searches by life stage and need rather than by broad audience
prerequis_orga: A media team able to run high-frequency search optimization rather than fully delegating to the algorithms
Marketing / data alignment on a shared definition of relevance and conversion
A legal basis and GDPR consent for the use of the data signals
stack_possible: An intent-scoring and query-to-product matching layer (in-house or agency)
A tool to measure conversion and dealership traffic

playbook.action: Map the available intent signals and the life stages to cover
playbook.livrable: A reference set of signals and need segments per model

playbook.action: Build the matching logic between search query and the relevant model
playbook.livrable: Rules or a model tying each query to an offer

playbook.action: Move from broad targeting to continuously adjusted search delivery
playbook.livrable: A media setup driven at high frequency on timing and dosage

playbook.action: Put in place conversion and dealership-traffic measurement to reallocate pressure
playbook.livrable: A reading loop linking media spend, conversions, and visits

replication.equipe: A search media lead, a data profile for signal aggregation and scoring, a brand marketing contact for model-message consistency.
replication.premiere_etape: Identify the usable intent signals (search, CRM, purchased data) and define how to read the life stage behind a query: that is what lets you move out of broad targeting.

statut_vivant.note: The AI-driven media setup is documented over January-May 2024; the agency-brand relationship and the search-relevance mechanics are a common operating mode, likely still in place, but no public 2025-2026 confirmation was found. Volkswagen retook the top of the Danish market over the full year 2024.

transposable_ue.note: Case already operated in the EU (Denmark). The setup relies on aggregated proprietary and purchased data signals to drive search delivery: collecting and using these signals assumes a GDPR legal basis and consent compliant with the market.
